headline: Issued order of conditions for 354 West Sutton Road; approved septic upgrade reviews at 11 Spring Hill Dr and 400 Boston Rd.
summary: Ratified an emergency certificate for 128 Armsby Rd and issued a certificate of compliance for 231 Manchaug Road. Burbank Road drew a long discussion about wetland replication and unfinished road work. A workshop on Tuesday, 8/25, at 3pm will cover agent versus consultant roles and fees.
decisions: Issued order of conditions for 354 West Sutton Road, 4-0-0.
Approved negative determination for septic system upgrade at 11 Spring Hill Dr, 4-0-0.
Approved negative determination for septic system upgrade at 400 Boston Rd, 4-0-0.
Approved minutes from 7/22/26 with corrections, 3-0-1, with one abstention.
Issued complete certificate of compliance for 231 Manchaug Road, 3-0-0.
Ratified emergency certificate for 128 Armsby Rd, 4-0-0.
Agreed to hold a workshop on agent versus consultant and fees on Tuesday 8/25 at 3pm.

transcript:
# SUTTON CONSERVATION COMMISSION

**Meeting Minutes**

**August 19, 2026**

**Approved** [handwritten signature]

Pursuant to Governor Healey's directive extending the temporary Open Meeting provisions until June 30, 2027, the Conservation Commission meeting will be conducted in a HYBRID format and will be recorded. *Recordings will be available on the Town's website and YouTube channel. *Please be aware: Participants attending via Zoom will have their video and audio disabled. *If you wish to engage in discussion, raise your hand; if acknowledged by the Chair, you will receive a pop-up message allowing you to unmute yourself. For agenda, YouTube, and Zoom links, please visit www.suttonma.org/cable-department.

Present in person: W. Wence, M. McGovern, T. Thompson, J. Marran, B. Faneuf - consultant

Unavailable: J. Duval

## Public Hearing(s)

**6:00 pm 11 Cote lane**- continued in error on the agenda. ORAD issued at 8/5/26 meeting.

**6:00 pm 354 West Sutton Road-Cont.** M. Bacon presented revised plan per request from 8/5 meeting.

Motion: Close public hearing T. Thompson

2nd: M. McGovern

Vote: 4-0-0, W. Wence-yes, M. McGovern-yes, T. Thompson - yes, J. Marran-yes

Motion: Issue order of conditions T. Thompson

2nd: M. McGovern

Vote: 4-0-0, W. Wence-yes, M. McGovern-yes, T. Thompson - yes, J. Marran-yes

## Discussion:

**11 Spring Hill Dr -RDA-** Septic system upgrade R. Mankaryous. Septic repair in lawn area. B. Faneuf recommended condition of double erosion line at wetland. M. McGovern agreed to double up where needed.

Motion: Issue negative determination T. Thompson

2nd: M. McGovern

Vote: 4-0-0, W. Wence-yes, M. McGovern-yes, T. Thompson - yes, J. Marran-yes

**400 Boston Rd- RDA-** Septic system upgrade L. Dupre Engineer Clear Water Environmental. Septic repair in lawn area.

Motion: Issue negative determination -T. Thompson

2nd: M. McGovern

Vote: 4-0-0, W. Wence-yes, M. McGovern-yes, T. Thompson - yes, J. Marran- yes

## Board Business

**Approve Minutes from 7/22/26 and 8/5/26 8/5**

Correction to minutes of 7/22/26. T. Thompson was listed as being present and voting. He was not at that meeting.

Correction to minutes of 8/5/26 - 11 Cote Lane ORAD was issued and should not have been continued.

Motion: To approve the minutes from 7/22/26 with corrections- J. Marran

2nd: M. McGovern

Vote: 3-0-1, W. Wence-yes, M. McGovern-yes, J. Marran-yes T. Thompson - abstained

Motion: To approve the minutes from 8/5/26 with corrections- M. McGovern

2nd: J. Marran

Vote: 4-0-0, W. Wence-yes, M. McGovern-yes, J. Marran- yes T. Thompson -yes

**Bills Payable**

B. Wence -stated recent bill to pay for $1,604.17 Ecosystems

**Certificate of Compliance**

**231 Manchaug Road** DEP 303-0825

Motion: Issue complete COC- T. Thompson

2nd: J. Marran

Vote: 3-0-0, W. Wence-yes, T. Thompson - yes, J. Marran- yes

M. McGovern recused as abutter.

**Emergency Certificate:**

**128 Armsby Rd** Ratify emergency certificate

Motion: to ratify emergency certificate -T. Thompson

2nd: M. McGovern

Vote: 4-0-0, W. Wence-yes, M. McGovern-yes, T. Thompson - yes, J. Marran- yes

**135 Dodge Hill Rd-** R. Mankaryous. Minor field change discussion to eliminate cultecs in ground and replace with trees/shrubs.

J. Marran would like revised change on plan. B. Faneuf to do site visit.

W. Wence-recused

## Enforcement Issues:

**72 Main Street**- no updates, under control of the Town of Douglas

**320 Putnam Hill Rd-** J. Marran did site visit 8/13/26 and provided update. Silt fence was installed correctly. Waiting on contractor to determine location of stockpile and will set up silt fence for that area.

**Burbank Road-**J. Lenihan. B. Faneuf visited site 8/19/26, M. McGovern/B. Wence did site visit 8/13/26 w/ J.Walsh Graves Engineering. B. Faneuf wetland replication needs two growing season 75% of replication area has to be populated by Indigenous species. Wetland area is compliant. One dead oak and two others that are flagging. Area along road is growing grass that is not a wetland species. Recommend getting Wetland science to review and give update of what needs to be done if anything. J. Lenihan will reach out to G. Krevosky to review. M. McGovern-was hoping to find a more completed project, that roadway was conditioned to be done prior to home construction. Swale along left side of driveway not completed, at end of bridge equipment was stored in wetland area. Elevation on right side of driveway different than plan and no swales or check dams completed. New plan should be provided with changes. J. Lenihan-project under construction, can't build swale in construction area. B. Wence that board had given until 7/31-8/1 to get road construction completed. Mike Scott engineer spoke of no visible erosion or sediment in wetland or equipment parked and that order is still valid. B. Faneuf per bylaw we have jurisdiction in catchment area. J. Lenihan stating that road construction being completed prior to house being built was never discussed. M. McGovern disagreed. B. Wence to send date/time of meeting for J. Lenihan to review. M. Scott- board just needs updated plan if changed. J. Marran-abutter - 99 Burbank (project across street) rain on night of 8/17 silt fence line per BOH on 100'wetland line. Silt fence failed per rain. Materials from site made it into area of Sutton Conservation. J. Lenihan- silt fence failure was from well driller test, not from rain. Fence was installed by S&S Farms, J. Couture reviewed and did not see as an issue. B. Wence if you are going to be in con com jurisdiction-need to file. If out of our jurisdiction-not a con com issue. Action items for 126-B. Faneuf-for next meeting- have Glenn review wetland replication area, update plan if needed, B. Wence to provide meeting time/date of road build out discussion.

J. Marran recused

**17-19 Pine Point Road-** tree removal complaint-had already been approved five years ago. No discussion

## Other Board Business

**Sutton/Douglas meeting schedule-** no need to discuss as Agent for both towns no longer employed.

**Discuss local Fees, consultant/subcontractor, & 53G** - B. Wence feels that projects of applicants should be paid by applicants not taxpayers. M. McGovern said bylaw allows for 53G and to implement. B. Faneuf- you can change bylaw fee. T. Thompson-review what other towns charge and if they have an agent. M. McGovern reviewed Shrewsbury and Grafton. Can we change fee structure without changing bylaw? M. McGovern we should increase fee structure. Need to know what expectations are of new agent. If we continue w/Douglas each town would have 16 hours. B. Wence spoke to T. Mahoney and based on her six months of filling in they both agreed the clerical position was about 16-18 hours, not leaving much time to do outside work and the possibility of delaying applicants. We can have a workshop meeting to discuss that is open to the public but not recorded. B. Wence read in fiscal year 2026 back to 2008 all fees paid by applicants not tax payers to Ecosystems for board to understand cost. M.McGovern asked what Wanda's salary was to run con com for the past years and what does it cost to run conservation. B. Wence recommended continuing with a clerical position and putting consultant out to bid. M.McGovern based on what budget we have to continue with a consultant, as we don't have enough to budget. M. McGovern said until further notice all conservation goes back to B. Faneuf until a new position is filled. J. Marran has asked if an amendment to fee schedule would allow us to take money from 53G and "rename" to another account, if applicable by law. In short-term we revert to what we were doing prior to the agent being hired. M. McGovern said anything prior to agent being hired still be funded to Brandon's company, as past agent had returned all fees without permission of the board. B. Faneuf asked that his company/role be put out to bid. J. Marran said we need an overlap for new hire and consultant. M. McGovern asked who is doing accounting and refunds. Board agreed to hold a workshop meeting to discuss agent vs consultant and fees on Tuesday 8/25 @ 3pm.

Motion to adjourn: T. Thompson

2nd: M. McGovern

Vote: 4-0-0, W. Wence-yes, M. McGovern-yes, T. Thompson - yes, J. Marran

Adjourned: 8:03 pm
